title: Single step of the borrow operation
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose find mode, and let $x$ be an input word. For any base host configuration, input-head position, and words $v$ and $u$, one step from control phase 8 with the counter tape storing $vu$, its head at $|v|$, and the other designated tapes blank has the following effect: if $u$ is empty, the machine enters phase 10, the counter tape stores $v$, and its head moves to $|v|-1$; if $u$ begins with true, it enters phase 9, changes that first bit to false, and moves the head to $|v|-1$; if $u$ begins with false, it stays in phase 8, changes that first bit to true, and moves the head to $|v|+1$. In each case the input position and output are preserved.
